$comment: site shape: { name, home, logo: { light, dark? } (media ids), logoHeight, labels: { navigation, submenu, menu, closeMenu, phone?, theme? }, header: { menu: [{ label, href?, children?: [{ label, href }] }], phone: { text, tel }, cta: { label, href }, sticky }, themeToggle }. An item with children and no href draws its label as the span form. The span toggle carries no type, which only the button form has (SC-019). The menu's second item has three children and no url, so its label is a span with tabindex 0 and its toggle the span form (aria-hidden, before script). The current page is the second child, so that item carries data-current-section and the sublink aria-current. The phone +44 1935 123456 gives tel:+441935123456 (section#display-forms).
summary: Light logo image drawn 48px high, a four-item menu whose second item has three children (one current), a phone number, a call to action and the sticky setting on.
